name.km: គុយទាវតៅហ៊ូ

description: Cambodia's beloved breakfast noodle soup in a clear pork-and-dried-seafood broth.
descriptionKm: គុយទាវ — ភ្ញាក់ព្រឹកដ៏ល្បីរបស់ខ្មែរ។
equipmentKm: ឆ្នាំងស៊ុប

ingredients.notes: cubed and lightly fried until golden

ingredients.itemKm: សណ្ដែកបណ្ដុះ
ស្លឹកខ្ទឹមបារាំង និងវ៉ាន់សុយ
ប្រេងខ្ទឹមចៀន
ទឹកស៊ុបជ្រូក ឬ មាន់
មឹកស្ងួត ឬ បង្គា
ingredients.notesKm: សម្រាប់ទឹកស៊ុប

instructions.text: Simmer the stock with dried seafood, rock sugar and a little fish sauce for 30 minutes; keep hot.
instructions.tip: Skim the broth often to keep it crystal clear.

instructions.text: Cook the tofu (cubed and lightly fried until golden) in the broth until done; slice if needed.
Blanch the noodles and bean sprouts; divide between bowls.
Top with the tofu and ladle over the hot broth.
Finish with fried garlic oil, spring onion and coriander; serve with lime, chili and herbs on the side.
